debit.notes: Debit Card Help Desk toll-free 1800-180-4031 (also printed '1800 180 4031') is the 24x7 line for ATM/unauthorised/fraudulent-transaction grievances; landline 05946-250152 is the alternate 'To Block Debit Card instantly' number; 8069840140 is only for non-ATM queries, 10 AM-6 PM, dial with 0/+91 prefix, closed 2nd/4th Saturdays, Sundays and bank holidays. Lost-card FAQ action: call 1800-180-4031 or 05946-250152 to get the card blocked, or set the card limit to 'zero' temporarily via the Sarvatra CardSafe app (also shows card status active/block); androidApp/iosApp are the generic store links the debit-card page publishes, no app-specific deep link. Card T&C require a police report for lost/stolen cards, and the bank hotlists/cancels during working hours on a working day after intimation. The Debit Card Help Desk email atmhelpdesk@nainitalbank.co.in is published alongside the instant-block numbers. Unauthorised electronic transactions can be reported online via the bank's CGRMS portal cms.nainitalbank.bank.in (Digital Complaint: ATM/UPI/E-Com/POS/Mobile Banking). No SMS block format, no overseas numbers, and no netbanking card-block path are published; the bank's own pages do not mention 1930.

credit.notes: No credit-card product or credit-card blocking channel is published on the bank's official site: product navigation on every page and the sitemap list only a debit card and Kisan Credit Card agri-loan schemes. The old entry's credit channels (1800-180-0251, 05942-230001, customercare@nainitalbank.co.in) appear nowhere on the live official site. For any card-fraud grievance the bank's published general contact is the 24x7 line 1800 180 4031.

upi.notes: The bank's UPI page publishes a dedicated 'UPI Help Desk Number & E-mail ID': 'TOLL FREE no : 1800- 180 – 4031', 'Land Line no : 05946 – 250152', 'E-mail id : mbshelpdesk@nainitalbank.co.in'; the site-wide footer also proves 'For ATM/Other Unauthorised /fraudulent transactions related grievance: 1800 180 4031 (24*7 Support)'. UPI runs through NPCI's BHIM or third-party apps ('PhonePe, Google Pay, PayTM etc.'): registration is 'selects the option - "Add a Bank" and selects "Nainital Bank"' then links the account to the VPA 'in the format mobilenumber@upi', with UPI PIN set 'using the last 6 digits of Debit Card and its expiry date'. No in-app UPI lock/freeze is published: the NAINI NEO mobile app's published 'Additional Features' list has no UPI transactions on/off toggle (nearest controls are 'De-Registration from the NAINI NEO Mobile Banking', 'Reset MPIN using ATM cum Debit Card', 'Reset TPIN using ATM cum Debit Card'), so androidApp/iosApp are the official NAINI NEO store links from the homepage hero, not a documented UPI-freeze path. No netbanking UPI manage/disable path is published (internet-banking features list only an 'AEPS (Aadhar Enabled Payment System) Enable & Disable Facility'), and no SMS block keyword or *99# USSD string appears on any bank page (FAQ lists 'UPI and E-Com transaction alerts' among SMS alert types only). Unauthorised UPI transactions can be reported online via the bank's CGRMS portal cms.nainitalbank.bank.in (website key) under 'Digital Complaint (ATM/UPI/E-Com/POS/Mobile Banking etc.)' with Track Status.
